observations: Blue reversed typed bleed-through distinguished from dark handwriting; no duplicate transcription of reversed verso text.
Canceled title phrase is heavily hatched: tentative de dualité. The first two words after it read avec un corps de base.

RHS exclamation-mark subscripts in two displays and the concluding R^j have dark repeated cancel strokes; preserved as deleted unsure(!), while the intervening prose R^{-i}_! retains its uncancelled exclamation mark.
Two displayed Hom arguments visibly carry coefficient subscript X; retained without replacing it by S.
Unbalanced closing parenthesis in middle display and clipped/unclosed lower display and G=DF parenthesis retained.
Lower conclusion changes finitude to an abbreviated constructiblt.; compressed final sentence explicitly marked where endings and wording are uncertain.
audit_observations: Independent audit of both halves with enlarged minus-i and final clause. Confirmed the dotted i in H^{-i}, the X coefficient subscript, crossed ! signs versus the uncancelled ! in the parenthetical claim, extra closing parenthesis and clipped right edge. The final verb looks like vaut, so that reading now precedes reste; plural endings after loc are not secure and are marked constant|constants. Doubled Z rendered mathbb.
